bullets.text: Vodafone Acquires VodafoneThree - Vodafone secures full control of VodafoneThree in a £4.3 billion deal, enhancing operational efficiency.
EE Enhances Scam Guard - EE's upgraded Scam Guard features AI Triple-Lock Protection to combat rising scam threats.
VMO2 Chooses Solar Power - VMO2 partners with Egg Power for a 10-year agreement to source renewable energy from a solar farm.
EE Expands 5G+ Network - EE utilizes world-first RAN coordination technology to enhance its 5G+ network capabilities.
